provides: Posts, comments, reactions and feeds for a community. Members post plain-text updates with up to ten uploaded pictures, public or for followers; others comment (flat, no threads) and react (one reaction per user per target, toggled, counted on the target in the same transaction). Four anchor-paginated reads: home (followed authors and own posts), public, one author's posts, one post with its comments. Following and blocks are read from profiles through one comm Function (profiles.social_graph); when it cannot be asked, home and public answer 503 rather than show a blocked author. Moderation takes a post or comment down through the moderation.completed verdict; GDPR erasure is a hard delete with counters recomputed.

gates.behavior: true: public/, authors/<id>/posts/, posts/<id>/ and its comments answer anonymous callers; false: they answer 401 to an unauthenticated caller. home/ is members only either way.

curated.summary: Whether people without an account can read the public feed, profiles' post lists and single posts with their comments. true (default): an open community. false: members only. Values: true, false.

gates.behavior: true: writes from a guest session answer error.403.write_requires_account (remediation reauthenticate); false: guests write like members.

curated.summary: Whether a guest session (no registered account) may post, comment and react. true (default): sign-in required. false: guests may write too. Values: true, false.

extension_points.name: SOCIAL_GRAPH_FUNCTION
extension_points.summary: Dotted comm Function name answering {user_id, limit} -> {following, blocked, truncated}. Default profiles.social_graph; a host with its own graph replaces it. Unreachable means 503 on home and members' public, never an unfiltered feed.

extension_points.name: REACTION_KINDS
extension_points.summary: The reaction vocabulary, default ('like',). Replace it to add 'heart' or others without a fork; an unknown kind answers error.400.reaction_kind_unknown.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_FEED_POST_PRESENTER / STAPEL_FEED_COMMENT_PRESENTER
extension_points.summary: Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the post and comment response presenters, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.

extension_points.name: feed.post.created
extension_points.summary: A post was published: post id, author, visibility. Bodies never ride the bus.

extension_points.name: feed.reaction.changed
extension_points.summary: A reaction was set or removed on a post or comment, with the target's author, so a projection or a gamification layer can count.

extension_points.name: moderation.completed
extension_points.summary: Consumed: a rejected verdict on a post or comment hides it from every read (the author sees it as blocked); an approved verdict on a blocked row publishes it again.

surface.name: fetch_graph
surface.intent: Ask SOCIAL_GRAPH_FUNCTION about one viewer; raises GraphUnavailable instead of guessing. home and public turn that into 503.

surface.name: graph_or_unknown
surface.intent: The degrading form for single-object reads: the graph, NOBODY for an anonymous viewer, UNKNOWN when the Function is down (only public content is then shown).

requires.reason: comm bus (feed.* emits, Functions, user.merged and moderation.completed consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings
profiles.social_graph (>=0.23) answers whom a viewer follows and whom to hide; profiles.public_cards renders author cards. Without the graph, home and members' public answer 503
uploads behind the attachment refs; cdn.describe_many fills the image objects (without it they keep the ref and say cdn_unavailable)
post and comment target types (registered by the stapel-social preset) read feed.moderation_content and take content down through moderation.completed
feed.comment_received and feed.reaction_received reach the post author
